Sprint 2 Retro
Period: Sprint 2
Team: Chartswap
Archived: October 10, 2026
Open approved actions (4):
• ACT-0001 — Adopt a 4-hour PR first-response target
  Teams: Dev Team | Target: 2026-10-10
  Define a team norm for first review comment or approval within 4 business hours; addresses idle reviews (FB-0003, FB-0005).
• ACT-0002 — Require acceptance criteria before sprint commitment
  Teams: Product Team, QA Team | Target: 2026-10-10
  Sprint-readiness checklist gate before stories enter the sprint (FB-0004, FB-0006).
• ACT-0003 — Run a post-deploy smoke test checklist
  Teams: Ops Team, Dev Team | Target: 2026-10-10
  Short post-deploy smoke tests after releases to sustain deployment reliability (FB-0001).
• ACT-0004 — Schedule weekly pairing blocks for knowledge sharing
  Teams: Dev Team | Target: 2026-10-10
  Regular pairing slots to extend a practice the team found effective (FB-0002).
Themes: Release and deployment reliability: The team reported that the deployment pipeline remained stable across all releases during the sprint. Collaboration and pairing: Pair programming was cited as helping the team complete the API migration more quickly. Code review responsiveness: Pull request reviews experienced multi-day idle periods; the team suggested a first-response target for reviews. Sprint readiness and acceptance criteria: Stories entered the sprint without clear acceptance criteria; the team proposed a readiness checklist before sprint entry.
